sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2023 Audi RS5 Sportback, finished in Nardo Gray with a black interior. The odometer on this RS5 displays about 5,000 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Audi’s past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Black Optic, Dynamic, RS Driver Assistance, Navigation, and Side Assist packages, LED headlights, a panoramic sunroof, Fine Nappa leather upholstery, heated and massaging front seats, heated rear seats, a Bang & Olufsen 3D sound system, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to 20-inch BBS wheels, tinted windows, and paint protection film on the door edges. Audi released the Sportback variant of the second-generation A5 for 2018. It was to the A4 what the A6 was to the A7: it was closely related to its sedan counterpart underneath the sheet metal, but it stood out with a swoopy, fastback-like silhouette. The RS5 is the top-of-the-line version of the A5, sporting large brakes, sportier suspension, and a muscular look that sets it apart visually from the standard trim. Power comes from a 2.9-liter twin-turbocharged V6, rated at 444 horsepower and 443 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission and Audi's Quattro permanent all-wheel drive system.
sections.Equipment: A window sticker is provided in the gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Black Optic Carbon Package (20-inch wheels, high-gloss black and carbon exterior trim) Dynamic Package (RS sport suspension plus with Dynamic Ride Control, RS sport exhaust system, red brake calipers) RS Driver Assistance Package (adaptive cruise control with Traffic Jam assist, active lane assist, hands-on detection steering wheel, head-up display with traffic sign recognition, top-view camera system, park assist) Navigation Package (Audi connect plus (subscription required), Audi MMI navigation plus) Side Assist Package (Audi side assist with pre sense rear, matte aluminum optic mirror housings) Matrix-design LED headlights with Audi laser light technology Black Audi rings and badges Panoramic sunroof Fine Nappa leather upholstery Carbon twill inlays Heated and massaging front sport seats Heated rear seats Heated multifunction steering wheel with shift paddles Audi virtual cockpit Ambient lighting 3-zone automatic climate control Bang & Olufsen 3D sound system
